SLEEK DESIGN – We have designed these business suit slacks with a stretchy waistband for perfect fit, flat front design, smooth zip fly closure, belt loops, two front pockets and back welt pockets, clean finished hem, and slim fit straight leg silhouette to flatter your figure with a trimming effect.

FLATTERING STYLE – This business casual slacks will elevate any outfit as it is thoughtfully designed to provide timeless classy looks while being comfortable to wear all day and night long. Pair this elegant outfit with your favorite dress shirts and shoes. Complete the look with an eye-catching tie and blazer jacket. Style this classic pant however you like to best suit you.
